item.title: LIVE da’i Sardo (Un’Caffè)
item.description: On Friday 2 October 2020 at 19:00, Radio Cavolo organised it’s first ever LIVE broadcast from Un Caffè Da’i Sardo. Cavolicious interventions & festive music on the programme! Come to say hi and request a song at the counter with your negroni. Join our FACEBOOK event!

item.title: Get ready to celebrate four years of Radio Cavolo, our beloved EUI-based independent radio!
item.description: Join us at Fiasco on March 15th to celebrate four incredible years of Radio Cavolo, our beloved EUI-based independent radio! Indulge in delicious food, groove to live performances by talented EUI musicians, and dance the night away to electrifying DJ sets. And if you dare, be part of the Radio Cavolo magic by getting your voice on air!
